podcast.title: Assistance on Kino's Debut
podcast.body: Musicians from Aquarium provided help to Kino during the recording of their debut album, "45," contributing to its creation. "Con la ayuda de varios músicos de Aquarium, que no grabó en 1982 fue album de Debout, 45."

srcs.episode: Viktor Tsoi. El padre del Postpunk Ruso

podcast.title: Role in Russian Rock Revolution
podcast.body: Aquarium was one of the bands that helped drive the Russian rock revolution, benefiting from the unprecedented creative freedom found at the Leningrad Rock Club. "ayudó a conducir la revolución del rock ruso de mandas como aquario, alisa o DDT."

xref.title: Jellyfish Species
xref.body: A jellyfish species, *And Phenema Rollins-I*, was named after Henry Rollins by Chad Widmer of the Monterey Bay Aquarium, who is a significant fan of Rollins. "Henry Rollins thinks of the fact that he has a jellyfish named after him. And Phenema Rollins-I speak to Chad Widmer of Monterey Bay Aquarium. He's the guy who did it. He's a big Rollins fan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
